judge_reasons: Core novelty claim holds, but a key quantitative claim (ANI 80-83% vs paper 76.8%) is reproducibly discrepant across three independent modern methods — genuine mismatch, though both values remain far below the 95% species threshold so the taxonomic conclusion survives.
Functional claims split: protease/peptidase confirmed (54 hits), but chitinase and β-1,3-glucanase NOT found — directly contradicts a specific paper claim, which alone precludes REPLICATED.
Incomplete coverage: AAI and dDDH deferred; all phenotypic claims OUT_OF_REACH; abstract-vs-body 22 kb genome-size contradiction is genuine but originates in the paper, not the replication.
coverage_assessment: Most genomic and phylogenetic claims adequately tested; AAI/dDDH gaps and phenotypic OUT_OF_REACH are acknowledged.
